body.prompt: A Korean woman in her late fifties sitting alone at a kitchen table late at night, holding a cup of tea with both hands, looking down, deep in thought, a single pendant lamp above her. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
